current_scope: B01 and B03 accepted (13% weighted Phase2). B02 native GNOME dependency implementation in progress; native graphical desktop/login/basic applications and B02 acceptance remain pending. B04 final runtime integration blocked; B05–B13/G2 and physical validation pending. Owner requests stopping after fully validated B02.

milestones.title: Inspect host and select isolated build environment
acceptance: Inventory actual CPU, RAM, storage, virtualization and installed build tools before making changes; then install/configure the necessary host/guest dependencies under ADR-0003 and record what changed.
Choose a disposable VM and record resource budgets, target disk identity, host/guest boundaries and recovery plan.
Run the selected versioned book host-requirement check in the designated environment and record missing prerequisites; H02 performs the final source freeze.

milestones.title: Freeze books, sources and integrity manifest
acceptance: Download versioned LFS/BLFS books and record SHA-256, exact editions and relevant errata.
Create a package/patch manifest with URLs, versions and upstream integrity data; reject mismatches before extraction.
Update config/books.lock.json to verified with actual hashes; document any mirror substitutions.

milestones.title: Prepare target, build user and package ownership
acceptance: Validate target paths and mounts; create the lfs user/environment inside the chosen guest.
Resolve D03 in an ADR and prototype file ownership, install/remove/upgrade and conflict detection before final builds.
Implement target guards, per-package logging and failed/success marker semantics; demonstrate a safe dry run.

milestones.title: Build the cross-toolchain
acceptance: Compile the book cross-toolchain in order, including binutils, compiler, headers and libc.
Validate compiler targets, linker search paths and an executable produced for the target.
Save per-package logs and source/install manifests; no host or temporary path leak remains unexplained.

milestones.title: Build temporary tools
acceptance: Build the frozen temporary-tool set with the correct target compiler and environment.
Verify expected tools, ownership and PATH without using accidental host substitutes.
Record package results; demonstrate restart of one safe interrupted step without marking failure successful.

milestones.title: Enter chroot and create recoverable checkpoint
acceptance: Mount only the intended guest virtual filesystems and enter the target chroot.
Build the additional temporary tools; capture environment and dependency sanity checks.
Create a checkpoint and demonstrate restoration of a controlled reversible change.

milestones.title: Build and test the final base system
acceptance: Compile the final base packages in frozen book order and track installed file ownership.
Run critical libc/compiler/binutils suites and classify expected versus unexplained failures using primary sources.
Compile/run a C program in the final environment and inspect linkage for host or temporary-toolchain dependencies.

milestones.title: Configure identity, services and basic networking
acceptance: Set os-release, hostname defaults, locales, console, users, time and filesystem configuration.
Configure the selected init/services and minimal network path; record BLFS additions if needed.
Use no reusable published password or baked-in account/API secret; provide an explicit test-login strategy.

milestones.title: Build kernel and boot configuration
acceptance: Record the release CPU baseline and build kernel support for target storage, VM devices and filesystems.
Configure bootloader/kernel command line for BIOS and UEFI test targets.
Save configuration and hashes; verify early boot logs and document driver/firmware exclusions.

milestones.title: Assemble the live system
acceptance: Create initramfs, compressed root and writable live overlay without embedding host mounts.
Demonstrate correct root discovery and volatile-write behavior in a guest.
Document persistence limits, rescue access and boot failure diagnostics.

milestones.title: Produce hybrid ISO and artifact manifest
acceptance: Generate a hybrid BIOS/UEFI image from declared inputs and record artifact SHA-256 and size.
Produce component/source/license inventory and image assembly logs.
Keep binaries outside Git and verify the distribution contains no development credentials.

milestones.title: Verify foundation boot matrix and recovery
acceptance: Boot/login in QEMU BIOS, UEFI and virtual USB; retain sanitized serial logs and commands.
Run uname, filesystem/shell checks and compile/execute C in the target.
Exercise controlled failure/checkpoint recovery; record physical hardware as pending unless actually tested.

milestones.title: Deliver and accept foundation gate G1
acceptance: Review all G1 requirements against actual evidence; no unclassified critical failure remains.
Deliver ISO/checksum/manifest references, live-media instructions, known issues and the Phase 2 handoff.
Record the G1 result explicitly; an untested physical boot is not represented as a pass.

milestones.title: Freeze the minimal Toddy architecture and delivery slices
acceptance: Record pinned GNOME/native UI/Pi engine candidates, a minimal successful tool spike and license/runtime review; no mandatory proprietary or hosted runtime.
Define the minimal default application set, optional developer tools and compatible third-party driver/firmware sources without enabling Ubuntu repositories.
Record reference hardware/VM settings, measured baseline and numeric budgets with a small-commit execution checklist.
Document the customizable profile/config/skill interface, precedence, task revision and independent policy boundaries before UI/service implementation.
Freeze the UI/engine bridge, early installer/package/image feasibility and one CPU-model contract, with build-versus-runtime budgets and no-write spike evidence.

milestones.title: Deliver the minimal branded GNOME desktop
acceptance: Login and basic browser/files/terminal/editor/network/audio work in the reference guest using pinned owned packages.
The desktop stays usable without keys, models, network or active agent/inference; optional network applications fail clearly.
Publish the minimal package manifest, resource measurements and optional-app packaging status; no unsupported package is advertised as working.
New browser/XML/network/privileged consumers have recorded security/ABI review and owned pinned dependencies; no silent frozen-foundation upgrade bypasses a failure.

milestones.title: Connect provider adapters and one optional local AI profile
acceptance: Advertised provider families pass focused streaming/tool/error/cancellation fixtures; live-tested versus fixture-only support is explicit.
One actual llama.cpp model profile completes a harmless offline tool task with recorded version, license, resource limits and no hidden cloud fallback.
API/local/deferred backend choices and verified resumable model downloads work without exposing keys or requiring paid resources.

milestones.title: Deliver native tools and the revocable privileged executor
acceptance: Native tools use validated authenticated IPC; ordinary tasks run unprivileged and authorized administrative actions actually work.
The owner can grant session/standing full administration, inspect actions and revoke future dispatch without granting root to the conversational service.
Focused wrong-user, malformed-request, revocation and malicious-content checks pass; keys do not enter model context or audit exports.
Conflicting writes are serialized and a grant revoked between planning and dispatch is rejected independently of model behavior.

milestones.title: Persist tasks and recover interrupted system changes
acceptance: Tasks survive a service restart without duplicating a known side effect; uncertain outcomes wait for review and retries remain bounded.
Stop prevents queued/new actions and terminates or reports active managed processes; revoke immediately blocks new privileged dispatch.
One configuration rollback restores service operation, preserves a manual rescue path and reports drift without fighting user intent.
Invalid profile configuration preserves the working revision; one rollback and task-revision pinning check pass without unexpected replay.
A crash after an effect but before result recording is reconciled or held for review; package/boot Stop respects a documented safe commit boundary.

milestones.title: Deliver Toddy quick entry, native UI and first-run setup
acceptance: Shortcut/launcher opens focused native entry; conversation, real task progress, history, errors and Stop work through desktop and CLI/TUI.
API/local/later setup works per user with protected credentials; deferred setup leaves the OS usable and local mode never silently changes provider.
Basic keyboard/focus, EN/PT copy and Stop smoke pass; publish an honestly labeled interim text preview rather than claiming G2.
The user can customize the harness through profiles/settings, reject invalid changes, restore a revision and export/import without credentials or administrative grants.
UI/IPC reconnect retrieves the existing task instead of replaying it; locked/missing secret service never causes plaintext credential fallback.
Optional software selection/review remains usable with the agent absent, recovers pending choices and does not install without current authorization.

milestones.title: Deliver inspectable local memory and portable backup
acceptance: Store, retrieve with source, correct and delete a preference with per-user isolation and retention controls.
Export/restore preserves canonical data and deletion reaches FTS/any derived index; secrets are excluded.
Record latency on the small fixed fixture; SQLite/FTS is sufficient for the preview and no vector daemon is mandatory.
Two profiles keep memory isolated; explicit memory export/delete and editable user preferences stay consistent with canonical storage.
Interrupted migration/restore preserves the last valid canonical store, and deletion cannot resurrect preferences from USER.md or retrieval caches.

milestones.title: Deliver quiet health monitoring and one persistent automation
acceptance: One schedule survives restart and a representative authorized workflow runs once without overlapping or replayed effects.
Disk/service monitoring stays quiet when unchanged; notifications occur only on meaningful actionable changes.
Cancellation and resource/cost bounds work without a paid model call for deterministic unchanged checks.
Missed-run behavior is explicit; import/clone never enables schedules or copies standing grants.

milestones.title: Deliver optional push-to-talk and spoken Toddy responses
acceptance: Short Portuguese/English push-to-talk input and intelligible spoken output work on the tested profile with separate model/voice licensing.
Microphone/device/loading state and interruption are visible; text continues to work with speech disabled.
Transcripts follow existing permissions; latency/offline/device evidence is explicit and no always-listening mode is enabled by default.

milestones.title: Deliver a bounded plugin interface and one MCP integration
acceptance: Versioned plugin schemas and one actual local MCP integration work end to end with timeouts and separate credentials.
Removal/revocation blocks further calls; plugin discovery/install/update grants no implicit account access or administrative privileges.
One focused capability-denial and isolation check passes; optional external connectors are honestly unverified or disabled.
One user skill loads only when relevant; unknown code/hooks stay disabled and skill instructions cannot override executor policy.
One opt-in browser tool navigates/reads a harmless local page with an isolated test profile, explicit Stop/error behavior and no authority inherited from page content.

milestones.title: Integrate the navy brand and nerdy Toddy installer scenes
acceptance: The exact approved logo/mascot remain unchanged and the actual guest login/desktop/Toddy use coherent navy assets with readable light/dark/focus states.
Installer scene assets show GNOME/Toddy workflow previews and concise nerdy affectionate dog personality; concept versus real capture is explicit.
Dimensions, Git-recoverable original provenance, exports and actual guest screenshots are recorded; repository design work alone earns no guest acceptance.

milestones.title: Deliver guided offline installation and optional software setup
acceptance: Exact virtual disk plan and safe pre-write cancellation work; blank-disk installation boots without ISO twice with persistent user data/settings.
AI/API/later and optional OpenCode/VS Code selections use verified backends, protected first-run secrets and resumable offline/deferred behavior.
Third-party drivers/firmware/software choices disclose source/license and enforce hardware/kernel compatibility with tested transaction rollback and a rescue/open fallback.
Basic native install/remove/upgrade, config preservation, signature/conflict rejection and one failed-update recovery pass; unsupported advanced disk/boot features are explicit.
The installer includes coherent navy GNOME/Toddy scenes and affectionate nerdy dog copy while progress, errors and destructive choices remain clear.
The installed system removes live-only accounts/autologin, regenerates machine identity and contains no inherited secrets or private signing keys; persistence and rescue are verified.

Final optional app selection defers acquisition to the installed user; qualified native/Flatpak paths reuse the catalog, transaction backend and pending manifest without blocking offline base completion.

milestones.title: Deliver the basic-tested experimental owner preview and G2
acceptance: The exact installed release candidate passes the focused mandatory smoke matrix, with no unexplained critical safety or basic-function failure.
Deliver ISO/checksums/source-build-license inventory, recovery instructions and a concise owner guide with passed/failed/deferred/not-run evidence and test durations when measured.
Broader hardware/model/accessibility/soak validation is explicitly delegated to owner-use backlog; VM-only and experimental status are truthful and no deferred test is marked passed.
The installed preview supports a working customizable default harness, safe profile changes/restore and no imported privilege grant under S24.

The exact release provides all accepted B components and verifies both the offline base and acquired full-experience configuration, with installed-image hygiene and browser integration; earlier incomplete previews are not reused as final acceptance.
